gems.title: 安昂传奇：最后的气宗
gems.summary: 派拉蒙和尼克宣布“降世神通”系列开发三部新的电影，仍是动画形式。第一部由《降世神通：最后的气宗》导演Lauren Montgomery执导，《最后的气宗》主创Bryan Konietzko和Michael DiMartino担任制片人。
gems.summaryEn: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture.
gems.whyWatch: 经典动画IP回归，原班人马打造，情怀与创新兼具。
gems.whyWatchEn: Classic animation IP returns with original creators, blending nostalgia and fresh storytelling.
gems.audience: 《降世神通》系列粉丝、动画爱好者与家庭观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of Avatar: The Last Airbender, animation lovers, and family audiences

gems.title: 奥德赛
gems.summary: 特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯踏上了返回家乡的艰险旅程。
gems.summaryEn: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters,
gems.whyWatch: 史诗级神话改编，奥德修斯的归乡之旅，冒险与人性深度兼具。
gems.whyWatchEn: Epic mythological adaptation of Odysseus' journey home, blending adventure and profound human themes.
gems.audience: 希腊神话爱好者、史诗冒险片粉丝与历史题材观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of Greek mythology, epic adventure films, and historical drama enthusiasts
